title: 第11章 一甲子法力第12章 军训
slug: 别人听劝仿明星你开局扮神明
content_zh:
如此景象，让那些劝说不要拜了的网友们，都有些恍惚了。
【要不是主播屁股底下坐着的真的是椅子，我还真以为是雷祖亲临了！
【主播！
你跟身后的神像就差个神兽麒麟了！
【啥也别说了，我家这里要是也干旱，见了主播这么像的人，我高低也得拜一拜。
林楠的样子实在是唬人，让每个第一次进入直播间的网友，都忍不住抬头看了看标题，想要确认自己进入的到底是不是扮演类的分区。
再加上直播间因为评论和礼物的缘故，热度不断的上升，直播间的推荐流量也更多起来，在线人数蹭蹭的上涨。
礼物更是刷了满屏，其中不乏刷上香之类的礼物的人。
很多人认为林楠如此像，没准就是神明转世，拜一拜总是没有坏处的。
这就导致了林楠的直播间一窜再窜，pk掉了许多长腿黑丝的小姐姐，进入了扮演区直播间的前五十名！
咚！
当直播间里提示“该直播间进入分区前五十名”
的时候。
坐在上铺拿着手机看评论的王成宇，激动的一个起身，脑袋直接撞在了天花板上，疼的他是呲牙咧嘴的。
但他却迅速的用手捂住了嘴，不敢发出任何的声音来，生怕影响了林楠的直播。
林楠更是忍得辛苦，并且还在配合着网友们的要求，做出与的多张神像图上的雷祖相似的动作。
当林楠摆了十好几种姿势，终于将网友的要求全部做到之后，耳边忽然又响起了那熟悉的声音。
【恭喜主人再次扮演雷祖，并完成建议：】
【⑥了解雷祖知识，还原神态与性格。
⑦法器雌雄双鞭和五雷令牌。

【扮演完成度增加：2%】
【恭喜主人扮演雷祖的完成度突破5%！
获得奖励：一甲子法力！
听到奖励内容，林楠不由得一愣。
一甲子法力？
如果按照字面意思来看，相当于他现在拥有了一甲子的神仙的法力？
真假的啊？
林楠疑惑，只能咨询系统。
很快，他便恍然大悟。
原来之前阵法没有发挥应有的作用，不是他的阵法画的不对或者是咒语不对。
而是他没有法力！
content_en:
Such a scene made those netizens who tried to persuade them not to worship in a daze.
[If it weren’t for the chair sitting under the anchor’s butt, I would have thought Lei Zu was here in person!
【Anchor!
The only difference between you and the statue behind you is the mythical beast Qilin!
[Don’t say anything else. If my home is dry and I meet someone who looks like the anchor, I’ll have to pay my respects.
Lin Nan's appearance was so bluffing that every netizen who entered the live broadcast room for the first time couldn't help but look up at the title, trying to confirm whether he was entering the role-playing section.
In addition, the popularity of the live broadcast room continues to rise due to comments and gifts, the recommendation traffic of the live broadcast room is also increasing, and the number of people online is increasing.
The screen was flooded with gifts, including many giving gifts such as incense.
Many people think that because Lin Nan looks so similar, he might be the reincarnation of a god, and there is always no harm in paying homage to him.
This led to Lin Nan's live broadcast room running around again and again, PKing many young ladies with long legs and black stockings, and entering the top fifty in the live broadcast room in the acting area!
Boom!
When the live broadcast room prompts "This live broadcast room has entered the top 50 in the division"
time.
Wang Chengyu, who was sitting on the upper bunk and reading comments on his mobile phone, stood up in excitement and hit his head directly on the ceiling. He grimaced in pain.
But he quickly covered his mouth with his hand, not daring to make any sound for fear of affecting Lin Nan's live broadcast.
Lin Nan endured the hardship even more, and was still cooperating with the requests of netizens, making similar movements to Lei Zu in many pictures of the statues.
When Lin Nan posed in more than a dozen poses and finally fulfilled all the netizens' requests, the familiar voice suddenly sounded in his ears again.
[Congratulations to the host for playing Lei Zu again and completing the suggestions:]
【⑥ Understand the knowledge of Lei Zu and restore his demeanor and character.
⑦ Magical weapons: male and female double whips and five thunder tokens.
[Increase in role-playing completion: 2%]
[Congratulations to the owner for completing the role of Leizu by exceeding 5%!
Obtain reward: one meter of mana!
Lin Nan couldn't help but be stunned when he heard the reward content.
A pound of mana?
If we take it literally, it is equivalent to him having the magic power of a dozen gods now?
Is it true or false?
Lin Nan was confused and could only consult the system.
Soon, he suddenly realized.
It turns out that the previous formation did not play its due role. It was not because his formation was drawn incorrectly or because the spell was incorrect.
But he has no magic power!
